biography.influence: The stories of Sanātana Dharma remain a living tradition, inspiring new interpretations in literature, art, and media, and offering timeless lessons for the modern world.
biography.legacy: These stories have shaped the values, beliefs, and practices of countless generations. They continue to be retold in homes, temples, and schools, nurturing the moral and spiritual fabric of society.
biography.mythic_origin: The stories of Sanātana Dharma are drawn from the Vedas, Puranas, Itihasas, and folklore, reflecting the spiritual, ethical, and cultural heritage of India. They are designed to inspire, educate, and guide seekers of all ages.
roles: Sources of ethical and spiritual guidance
